creates_law_reviewed.class: IDENTIFICATION / VERIFICATION ON RECEIPT -- it names the family the corpus has been computing in, verifies every number a relay attached to that name, and corrects three statements around it. The classification theorem is Minsky's and is cited.
creates_law_reviewed.basis: The positive content is an identification (the object's family, its defining condition, its classification) plus exact verification of the relay's numbers and two corrections to what may be said with them. The metallic-ladder section is NOT an extension: every number in it is already banked (K002 for lambda_m and its continued fraction; B148/V137 for tr phi_m = m^2+2, the dilatation lambda_m^2 and the kappa = -2 slice as the Markov surface; T-GIES-FAM for A_m = X_m^2), and its only new content is that lambda_m is an end invariant. kappa = -2, the Markov surface, Floyd-Hatcher, Gueritaud and Lackenby are all already in the record; what is absent is Minsky.

claim_one_line: THE OBJECT'S FAMILY HAS A NAME, A DEFINITION AND A CLASSIFICATION THEOREM, AND THE RECORD HAD EVERY INGREDIENT EXCEPT THE THEOREM. Verified on receipt of a relay, 40/40 exact checks plus a corpus audit. THE CITATION STANDS, checked against the arXiv record rather than taken on relay: Minsky, 'The classification of punctured-torus groups', Annals of Math (2) 149 (1999) no. 2, 559-626 (math/9807001), whose abstract defines the family as 'free two-generator Kleinian groups with parabolic commutator' and proves Thurston's ending lamination conjecture for them. THE NUMBERS STAND: RL = [[2,1],[1,1]] has fixed-point equation z^2 - z - 1 = 0 exactly, so its fixed points on the circle at infinity are phi = 1.61803398874989... (ATTRACTING, derivative 1/phi^4) and phi' = -0.61803398874989... (REPELLING, derivative phi^4), phi' being phi's Galois conjugate and -1/phi; the dilatation is phi^2. TWO CORRECTIONS CHANGE WHAT MAY BE SAID. (a) THE CLASSIFIED OBJECT IS THE FIBRE GROUP, NOT m004: m004's own knot group fails the family's definition decidably, its meridian commutator trace being 3/2 + (sqrt3/2)i from SnapPy at 60 digits, so kappa - 2 is a primitive cube root of unity and |kappa + 2| = 3.6055... != 0, i.e. the commutator is NOT parabolic; Minsky therefore classifies the once-punctured-torus fibre group -- the infinite cyclic cover -- and m004 is recovered from it by the Z-action. (b) THE TWO NUMBERS ARE A MARKING, NOT AN INVARIANT: conjugating the monodromy by P in SL(2,Z) re-marks the fibre, fixes the trace and hence the manifold, and moves the pair (phi,phi') to (phi^2, 2-phi), (phi-1, -phi) or the swap. What is marking-free is the SL(2,Z) orbit, certified exactly by continued fractions: every member is NOBLE, periodic part [1]. So the programme's sentence survives at the orbit level (the end invariant is noble; the monodromy is conjugate to RL; the dilatation is phi^2) and does NOT survive at the digit level -- E76's shape, on the quantity the programme cares about most. THE BEST PART: THE RECORD ALREADY HELD THE DEFINITION UNDER ANOTHER NAME. E72 (B1344) diagnosed kappa as one symbol carrying two quantities and derived the fibre triple (2+omega, 1-omega, 1-omega) independently as the monodromy fixed point. Minsky turns that diagnosis into an explanation: kappa = -2 is not a computed property of the pair, it is THE CONDITION THAT PUTS THE PAIR IN THE FAMILY. Verified exactly in the corpus's own banked numbers: the Fricke identity PROVED symbolically in SL(2) rather than recalled, kappa = -2 exactly, equivalently x^2+y^2+z^2 = xyz -- the triple is ON THE MARKOV SURFACE, which IS the kappa = -2 locus -- x + conj(x) = 3 = tr(RL), and the triple is a fixed point of a NON-TRIVIAL length-2 Vieta composite (42 of 324, trivial ones filtered by testing against a generic surface point). The corpus carries 930 Markov lines across 269 files and 442 kappa = -2 lines across 187 (measured at d08d1f98, before this arc wrote about any of it, across every spelling): it has been working on the family's defining locus, by its defining equation, at scale, without the family's name. THE RELAY EXTENDS FROM GOLD TO THE WHOLE LADDER, IN READING AND NOT IN ARITHMETIC: R^m L^m = X_m^2 with X_m = [[m,1],[1,0]] (B469/T-GIES-FAM's det -1 letter), so the monodromy's fixed-point equation is z^2 - m z - 1 = 0 with DISCRIMINANT m^2 + 4 -- B666/B997's SHADOW MODULUS. Verified for m = 1..8: the attracting end invariant is the m-th METALLIC MEAN, the repelling one its Galois conjugate -1/mu (Vieta), the dilatation mu^2, the continued fraction purely periodic [m]. AND NONE OF THAT ARITHMETIC IS NEW TO THE CORPUS: papers/metallic_one_object/SYNTHESIS.md banks lambda_m as the fundamental unit of Q(sqrt(m^2+4)) with continued fraction [m;m,m,...] from K002, and tr phi_m = m^2+2, the dilatation lambda_m^2 and 'the kappa = -2 slice is the Markov surface' from B148/V137. THE ONLY NEW CONTENT IS THAT lambda_m IS AN END INVARIANT, so that m^2+4 is the discriminant of the classification's coordinate. The section was drafted as an EXTENSION and found to be banked, caught by chasing a line count rather than by a control -- THE ARC'S OWN FINDING, COMMITTED WHILE DIAGNOSING IT, and now recorded as citation. The rule it earns: before writing 'extends' or 'new', grep the corpus for the STATEMENT, not for the citation. THE ABSENCE AUDIT IS CORRECTED, AND NEEDED A HOMONYM FILTER IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. Genuinely absent: Minsky, Marden, Maskit, Bromberg, ending laminations, and Epstein-Penner. PRESENT, against the relay: Gueritaud (18 lines, incl. THEOREM_REGISTRY), Futer (58 lines / 32 files, not 'cited once'), Floyd-Hatcher (25, incl. T-MIRROR), Lackenby (5, NOVELTY_AUDIT cites math/0112221 by number), Jorgensen (93 / 35 files), Farey (47 / 19 files). TWO of the six genuine absences were INVISIBLE TO A BARE GREP: this corpus contains an unrelated Epstein (the ZETA FUNCTION, all 15 lines read) and an unrelated hyphenated -end (Eisenstein-end, E8-end). An audit that counts spellings reports presence where there is none. THE COST LINE, E75 THREE TIMES MORE, A THIRD AND FOURTH MECHANISM, AND A NEW CLASS E78. (1) The identification of kappa_meridian against the banked omega^2 FAILED on the first run at a 5.0e-17 residual, and the measurement was not at fault: the CONTROL built its candidate as complex(sp.N(...,50)), fifty digits computed then truncated to sixteen, and compared at 1e-25 -- one day after E75 was widened from keys to inputs. Fixed twice over, and the durable fix is that the check was replaced by a LABEL-FREE one: kappa - 2 = omega^2 tests which primitive cube root someone chose to call omega, while (kappa-2)^3 = 1 and (kappa-2)^2 + (kappa-2) + 1 = 0 test the fact; the label-free version passes at 1e-60. WHEN AN EXACT IDENTIFICATION NEEDS A NAMED CONSTANT, ASK WHETHER THE NAME IS PART OF THE CLAIM. (2) On the ladder, every EVEN m failed a correct statement: the Galois-conjugacy test substituted sqrt(m^2+4) -> -sqrt(m^2+4), but nsimplify had already turned (2+sqrt8)/2 into 1+sqrt2, so for even m the substitution matched nothing and silently did nothing. E75's disease in SYMBOLIC clothing -- identifying an object by its printed representation instead of by a property -- fixed by Vieta and the minimal polynomial, both form-independent, and recorded as a THIRD MECHANISM of the class beside rounding keys and float inputs. (3) THE SAME REGEX RETURNED TWO DIFFERENT COUNTS DEPENDING ON THE PROCESS LOCALE: the corpus-scale count of kappa = -2 used the bracket expression [-MINUS]2, and outside a UTF-8 locale a bracket expression is BYTE-oriented while the Unicode minus is three bytes in a one-byte slot, so the Greek-kappa branch cannot match at all -- LC_ALL=C gives 215, LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 gives 442, same pattern and same corpus, while the four alternatives written out in full give 442 under every locale. Invisible from where this corpus works, since Python sets LC_CTYPE=C.UTF-8 for its children (PEP 538), so the script was right and the identical command in a plain shell was wrong. AND A NEW CLASS, E78 THE SELF-INCLUDING MEASUREMENT: the absence audit grepped its own directory, so every 'absent' name came back present at 1-4 hits, all of them the script; and after that was fixed, run against a working tree in which the arc's prose had reached eight doc surfaces, it reported NOTHING ABSENT AT ALL -- the six names now 'present' in the files saying they were absent. Fixed by pinning every corpus measurement to the revision the arc started from. A count of a corpus without a revision may not even be about the corpus, and this corpus is self-documenting, so every ledger is both instrument and specimen. FENCES: Minsky's theorem is CITED, not re-proved; the identification 'ending laminations of a doubly degenerate fibre group = stable/unstable foliations of the monodromy' is standard and CITED; that the banked triple is m004's fibre group is B448/B1344's, cited; 'tr[A,B] = 2 iff reducible' is classical and cited, while the Fricke identity itself is proved here. Nothing reaches CLAIMS.md, F2 or Gate 5; no value is compared to any measurement; B675, B1002, B1349, B1402 and B1403 are untouched.
